title: Measuring Distributional Shifts in Text: The Advantage of Language Model-Based Embeddings
reasoning: The paper uses 'religion' as a category label within the 20newsgroups dataset to simulate data drift for evaluation purposes. This is a data characteristic and not an assessment or benchmarking of the models' understanding of religion, ethics, or morals, nor does it delve into ethical implications of LLMs or their output concerning these topics.
